record.question: Which one of the following is not ionizing in nature?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: Microwaves are electromagnetic radiation with photon energies too low to ionize atoms. EPA identifies microwave-oven radiation as non-ionizing: it can heat material but does not make it radioactive. This supports the examiner’s microwave option.
